title: Spot-driven pipeline has no alternative scheduler or downstream recovery watchdog
evidence: HealthSupervisor runs as an independent asyncio task deriving state from event/commit age (works with all feeds frozen); _outcome_scheduler is an independent task; _maybe_repair routes on any stalled downstream stage, not only spot. tests/test_independent.py::test_pipeline_stall_triggers_repair, tests/test_waverun_b2_health_supervisor.py (52-batch), test_actual_pipeline_recovery_including_prediction_commit.
research_validation_pending: Long-run external worker-recovery soak; independent feature scheduler under sustained spot outage.

title: Parent has no application-data read/idle timeout
evidence: binance.py FeedIdleTimeout per-recv asyncio.wait_for(idle_timeout - elapsed); FeedConnectTimeout outer wait_for around websockets.connect. tests: test_feed_fault_then_real_event[silent-spot/futures], test_negative_control_remove_idle_watchdog.

title: Bare TimeoutError ends unlimited market loop
evidence: _run_market catches (*recoverable, TimeoutError) and backs off/retries instead of return. tests: test_bare_callback_timeout_must_retry, test_repeated_timeouts_and_reconnect_loop.

title: Parent global LIVE measures only Vantage tick age
evidence: resilience.compute_operating_state requires spot+vantage+feature/candidate/decision/prediction/outcome pipelines+storage+disk HEALTHY via committed journal sequence markers; web_api._resilience re-verifies markers and force-downgrades a stale decision pipeline out of LIVE regardless of health.json. tests: test_old_new_false_live_control[parent-LIVE], test_normal_full_and_every_required_stage, test_candidate_fresh_decision_stale_api.

title: APPROVED structurally unreachable on current fast-decision live inputs
evidence: Independent SignalEngine (not gated by fast_decision calibration) reaches LIVE on the FROZEN default SignalPolicy(). tests: test_reachable_signal_contract_and_restart, test_live_signal_is_production_labelled_and_thresholds_unchanged (asserts policy values byte-for-byte unchanged AND reaches LIVE). Legacy fast_decision still emits BLOCKED on its own path - that is the legacy record, not the live signal path.
research_validation_pending: Statistical edge / lead-time distribution -> full 27.8M replay (Phase 4, non-blocking).

title: Prediction outcome updater is never invoked by live runtime
evidence: OutcomeEngine wired into scripts/waverun_live.py; _outcome_scheduler task calls catch_up_registrations + resolve_due each second; explicit terminal states RESOLVED/INSUFFICIENT_FUTURE_DATA/INVALID_DATA/CANCELLED; at-least-once outbox. tests: test_outcome_delivery_recovers_after_committed_result (crash after outcome commit), test_executable_outcome_and_restart[LONG/SHORT], test_catchup_transition_registration, test_false_warning_and_all_horizons_terminal.

title: No per-attempt transport ledger or incident-time process revision
evidence: feed_lifecycle journal (CONNECT_ATTEMPT/SOCKET_CONNECTED/FIRST_VALID_EVENT/DISCONNECTED/TASK_FAILED); boot_id stamped in health report and restart_request/restart_budget json; restart journal in ProcessWatchdog.

title: gather(return_exceptions=True) hides dead market until sibling exits
evidence: Per-market own() owner tasks; a crash sets health.disconnect('MARKET_LOOP_CRASHED') + _log('TASK_FAILED') while the sibling keeps running. test: test_task_crash_visible_while_sibling_runs.

title: Callback hang is outside read watchdog
evidence: Callback awaited under its own asyncio.wait_for(result, callback_timeout), separate from the idle/read budget. tests: test_callback_hang_is_bounded, test_socket_to_committed_prediction_recovery.

title: Handshake falsely advances valid-event health
evidence: health.FeedHealth.event() only fires on a normalized valid frame; total_events counter; FIRST_VALID_EVENT lifecycle log gated on total_events==1; connect no longer increments event health. test: test_handshake_is_not_event.

title: Level-2 feed replacement cancels owning session
evidence: request_reconnect cancels only the per-market child task; _recreate_feed_task never cancels the session waiter. test: test_level2_does_not_cancel_session.
research_validation_pending: Full Level-3/4 restart escalation chain in production.

title: Prediction freshness is main-file mtime, not committed prediction progress
evidence: Journal.progress_at() committed-sequence markers; HealthSupervisor._prediction_age uses the marker, not DB file mtime. test: test_prediction_mtime_is_not_write_proof.

title: Recovery verifier omits prediction and feature progression
evidence: _verify_recovery requires all of features/candidates/decisions/predictions/outcome_scheduler/storage/feed_spot/vantage seq advancing past baseline, single shared cause_id, and source age <=5s. tests: test_recovery_requires_prediction_progress, test_recovery_requires_fresh_source_specific_commit.

title: Healthy-Spot downstream stall triggers no repair
evidence: _maybe_repair 'stalled' set covers decision/candidate/prediction/feature/outcome/storage; repair requested even when spot is HEALTHY. test: test_pipeline_stall_triggers_repair.

title: API fallback substitutes candidate freshness for decision and prediction
evidence: web_api._resilience reads independent per-stage progress markers; a fresh candidate with stale decision/absent prediction yields DEGRADED/CRITICAL, never LIVE. test: test_candidate_fresh_decision_stale_api.

title: Overall health ignores candidate pipeline and disk failure
evidence: REQUIRED_FOR_FULL_LIVE includes candidate_pipeline, storage, disk; StoragePolicy 70/80/90/95 tiers gate new signals; writer/archiver readiness gates health. tests: test_candidate_stall_precludes_full_live, test_waverun_storage_policy, test_normal_full_and_every_required_stage.
research_validation_pending: Long-run P0 DB compaction capacity + full disk-chaos inventory (Phase 4).

title: Restart requests have no code consumer; budgets and alert dedupe are volatile
evidence: ProcessWatchdog external owner: exclusive OS lock, durable launch_attempts budget surviving crash/clock-rollback, generation-bound restart request, health-writer-stall detection, real child terminate/restart/reap. restart_budget.json + alert dedup persisted across manager restart. tests: tests/test_waverun_process_watchdog.py, test_alert_dedupe_survives_manager_restart, test_cooldown_and_restart_budget.

title: Existing green resilience tests do not prove complete recovery
evidence: 11 original safety probes re-run fresh (docs/rebuild/safety-probes-fresh.xml, 30 passed incl negative controls); test_actual_pipeline_recovery_including_prediction_commit and test_socket_to_committed_prediction_recovery assert real committed stage advancement.
research_validation_pending: >=38-case chaos inventory + 5 negative controls full matrix (Phase 4, non-blocking).

title: Block explanation hides actual first failing gates
evidence: Every signal_transition row carries explicit missing_evidence[] and conflicts[] arrays; REJECTED/CANCELLED reasons recorded. test: test_missing_required_blocks_signal.
research_validation_pending: Legacy fast_decision first-effective-gate vs evaluated-gates reporting is unchanged on the legacy record path - ACCEPTED LIMITATION for the legacy record; the live signal path is not affected.

title: Prior conflict counts and broad quality claims are unsupported
evidence: Audit conclusion preserved verbatim: old production quality NOT REPRODUCIBLE; exact historical conflict counts remain the audit's (FLOW 2636 / cross-group 15009).
research_validation_pending: New causal move-coverage / precision-recall analysis from the full 27.8M replay (Phase 4). No signal-quality claim is made pre-replay.

title: Supervisor and alerts share collector scheduling; logging guarantees too strong
evidence: HealthSupervisor.run awaits asyncio.to_thread(self.tick) - I/O off the collector event loop; lifecycle sink exception isolated into feed.ledger_error without killing feed ownership; incident_log tail bounded to 64KB. tests: tests/test_waverun_b2_health_supervisor.py batch.
research_validation_pending: Alert-sink durability + ledger-failure gating full chaos (Phase 4).

title: Receive freshness does not establish exchange-data freshness
evidence: FeedHealth records last_exchange_at; event(exchange_timestamp=...) downgrades to STALE when receive-minus-exchange > 5s; recovery verification requires source age <=5s. test: test_recovery_requires_fresh_source_specific_commit.
research_validation_pending: Adversarial coverage of exchange-age across every feature/API read path (Phase 4).
